quick_skim.title: DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization
quick_skim.abstract: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: DimPO uses listwise preference optimization to learn query/key projections that reduce attention dimension while preserving model behavior.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 线性投影可在不更新预训练模型的情况下降低查询和键向量维度，但何种训练目标最能保持模型行为尚不明确。本文提出DimPO，结合列表式偏好优化与轻量top-k交叉熵项来保持头保真度，离线从冻结语言模型的注意力模式中训练每层的共享投影。在多个模型上的长上下文实验中，该方法以更优的目标保持了注意力行为。
